counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把规格说明变成可运行的代码实现
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有一份规格说明,想直接得到实现代码
copy.tagline_en: Turn a spec into working code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a specification and want the code written for you

howto.what: 收到规格说明(spec)和任务票(tickets)后,Claude 会按依赖关系将其视为任务图,派出多个子代理并行实现就绪任务,合并到一个分支并创建拉取请求(PR),完成代码审查后标记为可评审。
howto.when: 当用户提供一份规格说明(spec)和对应的任务票(tickets),并要求将其实现为代码时触发。

say.text: 这是 spec 和 tickets,请按它们把代码实现出来。
say.note: Claude 会建分支和草稿 PR,并行推进任务。

say.text: 请把这份规格说明实现成代码,并管理好任务依赖。
say.note: 它会用多个子代理并行处理就绪的任务。

say.text: 我提供 spec 和 tickets,请实现并产出可评审的 PR。
say.note: 完成后会标记 PR 就绪并清理工作区。

howto.what_en: Given a spec and its tickets, Claude views them as a dependency graph, spawns parallel implementer subagents for ready tasks, merges into one branch, opens a draft PR, code-reviews, and marks it ready.
howto.when_en: When the user provides a spec with associated tickets and asks Claude to implement it in code.

say_en.text: Here are the spec and tickets. Please implement the code accordingly.
say_en.note: Claude will create a branch and draft PR, and work through tasks in parallel.

say_en.text: Please implement this spec and handle task dependencies.
say_en.note: It uses several subagents to work on ready tasks at once.

say_en.text: Give me a reviewable PR when done.
say_en.note: Claude marks PR ready after review and cleanup.
